papers.title: DKL: Decoupled Knowledge Learning for Instruction-Tuned Language Models
papers.abstract: RAG has become the de facto method for incorporating new, corpus-specific knowledge into an instruction following LLM (Instruct LLM). Although RAG-based prompting improves factual grounding, it fails when retrieval is incorrect or incomplete, leading to hallucinations. Finetuning methods such as RAFT and PA-RAG enhance RAG by injecting new knowledge into the model's parameters, but require generating a massive amount of synthetic QA that covers the entire corpus. Extended Pre-Training (EPT) on the text corpus avoids the need for comprehensive synthetic data generation but compromises an Instruct LLM's instruction-following capabilities, necessitating instruction fine-tuning (IFT) after pre-training. However, IFT is costly and may be infeasible due to the unavailability of an instruction-tuning corpus. In this work, we propose DKL-Decoupled Knowledge Learning for Instruction-Tuned Language Models. Instead of doing EPT on the Instruct LLM, DKL performs EPT on its corresponding base LLM to infuse new knowledge. These knowledge infused weights are then merged with the Instruct LLM, imparting new knowledge without affecting their instruction-following capabilities. DKL is a lightweight method that avoids expensive instruction fine-tuning and relies on model merging to infuse the new knowledge into the Instruct LLM without destroying its instruction following capabilities. Empirical results show that DKL improves RAG accuracy from 54.17 to 79.26 on retrieval failure cases, while outperforming prior approaches with substantially less training data.

summary.takeaway: In this work, we propose DKL-Decoupled Knowledge Learning for Instruction-Tuned Language Models.
summary.problem: RAG has become the de facto method for incorporating new, corpus-specific knowledge into an instruction following LLM (Instruct LLM).
summary.method: In this work, we propose DKL-Decoupled Knowledge Learning for Instruction-Tuned Language Models.
summary.evidence: Although RAG-based prompting improves factual grounding, it fails when retrieval is incorrect or incomplete, leading to hallucinations.

papers.title: From Reweighting to Rewriting: Unlocking the Intervention Effects of Influential Samples in Training Data Attribution
papers.abstract: Training data attribution (TDA) aims to identify training examples that shape model behavior, but its intervention value depends on both which examples are selected and how they are modified. Influence functions (IF) estimate behavioral changes under infinitesimal reweighting, yet IF-selected examples often show limited advantages over random selection under conventional weight-based interventions. This raises the question of whether influential examples lack intervention value or whether reweighting fails to realize their behavioral leverage.We introduce influence-guided response rewriting, which uses IF to identify intervention targets and replaces their responses with behavior-aligned or behavior-opposed supervision while keeping instructions fixed. Across four open-weight LLMs, we compare rewriting and reweighting on the same influence-selected examples using epistemic abstention as our primary testbed. Response rewriting produces stronger, more persistent, and bidirectional behavioral shifts, while reweighting the same examples yields weak and inconsistent effects. Further analyses show that influence-selected examples provide greater rewriting leverage than alternative selectors, with changes remaining concentrated on target-relevant behaviors. The same qualitative contrast extends to safety refusal. These results distinguish the local reweighting effects captured by influence estimates from the broader intervention leverage of the examples they identify, motivating intervention-aware evaluation of TDA methods.

summary.limitations: 评估仅限于 supervised fine‑tuning、四个模型和 abstention/safety 基准，未检验更广泛的泛化能力。
summary.evidence: 在四个 open‑weight LLMs 中，重写相较于删除或上调相同样本，能够在 epistemic abstention 和 safety refusal 上产生更强、更稳健、双向的变化。
summary.problem: 基于权重的对 influence‑selected 示例的干预相较随机选择优势有限，质疑其实用性。
summary.takeaway: influence‑guided response rewriting 相较于 reweighting，对有影响力的训练样本提供更有效且持久的行为干预。
summary.method: 通过 influence functions 选择高影响力样本，并在保持指令不变的情况下，用 behavior‑aligned 或相反的模板替换其响应。
summary.why_for_you: 契合您对数据选择和高效对抗训练的兴趣，展示了一种更有力利用 influential examples 的方法。

signals.text: 引入 influence‑guided response rewriting 作为一种新 TDA 干预，优于 reweighting。
使用 influence functions 选取样本，然后仅通过 template pools 中的固定提示重写响应。
在四个 LLMs 上展示了针对 abstention 和 safety 的更强、持久、双向行为变化，但仅限于这些任务。

deep_dive.overview: 本文研究了为何 influence‑function (IF) 选取的示例在传统 reweighting 下常未能提升模型行为。提出一种解耦框架：IF 确定高杠杆训练点，response rewriting 仅修改响应且保持指令不变，使用 behavior‑aligned 或相反的模板。对四个 open‑weight LLMs 的实证研究表明，与删除或上调相同示例相比，rewriting 能显著产生更强、更稳健且双向的 epistemic abstention 和 safety refusal 变化。分析显示，influential 示例蕴含潜在杠杆，rewriting 可在不削弱整体能力的前提下加以释放。

mechanism.detail: 重写会改变与有影响力示例相关的监督信号，直接引导模型向目标行为靠近或远离，同时保持提示不变。
mechanism.title: 通过监督信号重定向实现杠杆效应

mechanism.detail: 由于仅修改了响应，重写后的示例继续影响相同的输入分布，将干预集中在目标行为上，而不会造成广泛的能力损失。
mechanism.title: 目标特异性保持

methodology.detail: 为每个SFT训练示例计算IF分数，根据目标行为查询集对示例进行排序，从最有帮助（正分数）到最有害（负分数）。
methodology.title: 影响函数评分

methodology.detail: 将选定示例的原始响应替换为三个模板池中的固定字符串（abstention-refuse, safety-refuse, comply），同时保留原始指令。
methodology.title: 响应重写

methodology.detail: 在修改后的数据集上对基础LLM进行微调，使用相同的SFT配方和超参数，适用于不同模型规模（OLMo2-1B/7B, Qwen3.5-2B, Gemma3-4B）。
methodology.title: 微调设置

experiments.title: 模型与干预比较
experiments.detail: 在同一 IF‑selected 集合上，对四种开放权重 LLM 进行四种干预的评估：删除、加权、行为对齐重写和行为对立重写。

experiments.title: 评估方案
experiments.detail: 主要测试平台是使用来自 CoCoNot、SelfAware 和 KUQ 的 300 道题目的认知回避；安全拒绝通过独立安全基准进行评估。指标包括回避率变化和召回率差异。

experiments.title: 基线与对照
experiments.detail: 随机选择、基于探测的选择和基于投影的选择（高不可回答性）作为基线；所有干预在样本数量上保持一致。

findings.title: 重写优于加权
findings.detail: 相较于对相同 IF‑selected 示例的删除或加权，响应重写在回避和安全行为上产生更强、更稳健且双向的变化。

findings.title: 影响选择示例具有更高杠杆效应
findings.detail: 与基于投影或其他选择器基线相比，影响选择的样本在对齐重写下产生更大效应，在对立重写下产生相当效应。

findings.title: 目标聚焦的变化且不削弱能力
findings.detail: 分析表明，重写效应仍集中于目标行为，并未明显损害整体模型性能。

contributions: 基于 Influence‑guided 的 response rewriting 框架，将 example selection 与 intervention design 解耦。
实证表明，influential examples 包含通过 rewriting 解锁的隐藏 behavioral leverage。
阐述 rewriting 有效原因及其相对于其他 selectors 的适用范围。
limitations: 研究仅限于 supervised fine‑tuning 环境，未在 pre‑training 或 instruction‑tuning 流程中评估。
实验仅覆盖四个 open‑weight LLM 和两个 behavioral domains（abstention、safety refusal）。
rewriting 依赖手工构建的 template pools，可能无法推广至 arbitrary behaviors。
open_questions: Influence‑guided rewriting 能否扩展至更大的 closed‑source 模型和更丰富的 behavioral targets？
有哪些 automated methods 能在超出 fixed templates 的情况下生成有效的 rewrite 内容？
rewriting 对 downstream task performance 与整体 model alignment 的长期影响如何？

papers.title: Cliff: Learning Process Rewards from the First Mistake
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for large language model (LLM) post-training, but its reliance on coarse outcome rewards leads to limited guidance on intermediate reasoning processes. Existing approaches such as process reward modeling and on-policy distillation introduce additional constraints, such as reliance on a specialized reward model or assuming identical reasoning patterns between teacher and student. Nevertheless, we observe that once a reasoning process first goes wrong, evaluating the subsequent reasoning provides limited additional information, as it is already conditioned on an invalid prefix. Therefore, we propose Cliff, a reward shaping strategy that utilizes an off-the-shelf LLM as a teacher to identify the first mistake in each rollout. As a result, the rollout is naturally decomposed into two parts: a correct prefix and an incorrect suffix. Cliff then converts this signal into token-level advantages, assigning positive advantages for the correct prefix and negative feedback afterward. Experiments across 12 different scenarios demonstrate that Cliff consistently improves reasoning performance, outperforming on-policy distillation by 15% and standard GRPO by 7%, even with teachers of modest capability. Furthermore, we analyse the role of ``ground truth'' in Cliff and investigate its training dynamics. These results establish Cliff as a simple, general and effective approach for improving RLVR with richer, fine-grained supervision.

summary.limitations: 该方法依赖能够准确识别首个错误的 teacher，若缺少 ground‑truth filter，较弱的 teacher 将出现更大的性能下降。
summary.evidence: 在 12 种场景中，Cliff 相比 on‑policy distillation 提升 15%，相比 GRPO 提升 7%，对强 teacher 移除 ground‑truth filtering 时仅下降约 2%。
summary.problem: RLVR 中的 outcome‑only rewards 反馈稀疏，无法对中间推理步骤进行奖励。
summary.takeaway: Cliff 通过奖励至首个推理错误的方式，为 RLVR 添加细粒度的过程监督。
summary.method: Cliff 使用 off‑the‑shelf LLM teacher 定位 rollout 中的首个错误，并在其之前分配正向 token advantage，之后分配负向 advantage。
summary.why_for_you: 如果您从事 on‑policy distillation 或高效对抗训练，Cliff 提供一种简洁、信号更强的替代方案，可提升 RLVR 性能。

signals.text: Cliff 在 12 项任务上相较 on‑policy distillation 提升 15% 推理性能。
Cliff 使用 LLM teacher 找到首个错误，并将 rollout 划分以进行 token 级别的 advantage 分配。
对强 teacher 若无 ground‑truth filter，性能下降约 2%，对弱 teacher 则更大。

deep_dive.overview: Cliff 通过引入首个推理错误的位置这一粗粒度但信息丰富的过程信号，缓解 RLVR 中 outcome‑only rewards 的稀疏性。off‑the‑shelf LLM teacher 对每个学生 rollout 进行评判，标记最早的错误。随后将 rollout 划分为正确前缀和错误后缀，并相应分配 token 级别的 advantage。结合 Group Relative Policy Optimization，该方案在十二个推理基准上实现稳定提升，超越 on‑policy distillation 与标准 GRPO，且保持模型无关性。

mechanism.detail: 仅识别第一个错误即可提供足够的指导，因为后续推理基于已无效的前缀，类似于空虚蕴含。
mechanism.title: 粗粒度过程监督

mechanism.detail: 由于推迟错误总是产生更高的优势，奖励无法通过后期标记的简单操作被操纵。
mechanism.title: 奖励劫持抵抗

methodology.detail: 教师LLM评估学生轨迹并返回最早错误推理步骤（Pitfall Step）的索引。
methodology.title: 首次错误检测

methodology.detail: Pitfall Step之前的标记获得更高的（正向）优势分数；之后的标记获得负分数，这与GRPO类似，但使用了分割信号。
methodology.title: 优势塑造

methodology.detail: Cliff基于Group Relative Policy Optimization目标，用双段优势向量替代了统一轨迹优势。
methodology.title: 与GRPO的集成

experiments.title: 基准套件
experiments.detail: 使用了十二个推理场景（包括 GSM8k、MATH‑500、DAPO、AIME）；一个包含 50 条正确和 50 条错误回滚的人类标注子集用于评估评审质量。

experiments.title: 教师模型
experiments.detail: 评估了 Qwen3‑32B、Gemma3‑27B 和一款 SOTA 模型；表 1 报告了参考解答准确率（65–93%）、评审准确率（88–100%）以及与人工标注的平均 Pitfall‑step 距离。

experiments.title: 基线与指标
experiments.detail: 与 on‑policy distillation（OPD）和标准 GRPO 进行比较；改进以最终推理准确率的百分比提升来衡量。

experiments.title: 消融研究
experiments.detail: 将教师从双重 credit assignment 中剥离仅带来微小提升，证实 first‑mistake split 是性能的主要驱动因素。

experiments.title: 真实标签过滤器分析
experiments.detail: 去除过滤教师参考解答的 verifier 导致强教师（Qwen3‑4B、SOTA）准确率下降约 2%，而弱教师（Gemma3‑27B）下降至 2–3%。

findings.title: 性能提升
findings.detail: Cliff 在十二个任务上平均比 OPD 高出 15%，比 GRPO 高出 7%。

findings.title: 教师可靠性
findings.detail: 教师更高的问题求解准确率与更一致的 Pitfall‑step 识别相关（例如，SOTA 模型参考准确率 93%，误报为 0）。

findings.title: Credit assignment 重要性
findings.detail: 消融实验表明，仅将教师用作 reward model 只能带来小幅提升，而显式的 prefix‑suffix advantage assignment 则推动了大部分改进。

contributions: First‑mistake based reward shaping for RLVR
Teacher‑driven process supervision without training a separate reward model
Empirical validation of coarse process signals across diverse reasoning benchmarks
limitations: 需要能够准确定位首个错误的教师 LLM
当缺少 ground‑truth 验证的教师解答时，较弱的教师性能下降
主要在二元/可验证推理任务上评估；对非二元或对抗性场景的适用性尚未证明
open_questions: 首个错误信号能否扩展到具有连续或多维奖励的任务？
教师规模、判断准确性与整体训练效率之间的权衡是什么？
自动化、无模型检测器能否取代 LLM 教师进行首个错误识别？

papers.title: Large Language Models (LLMs) for Telecom Root Cause Analysis (RCA): A Structured Reasoning Framework for Evidence-Grounded Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) is a critical task in telecom network operations, but diagnosing performance degradations in modern 5G and emerging 6G networks remains challenging due to complex cross-layer dependencies. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising capabilities for reasoning and knowledge integration, directly applying vanilla LLMs to telecom RCA often leads to hallucination, unstable reasoning, and poor alignment with structured network evidence. This work first reviews the evolution of telecom RCA from rule-based and machine learning (ML) approaches to emerging LLM-enabled techniques, and provides an overview of recent paradigms, including structured reasoning, retrieval-augmented knowledge grounding, agentic orchestration, and verifiable reasoning. Building upon these insights, we propose a structured reasoning framework for LLM-enabled telecom RCA that aligns diagnostic reasoning with telecom-specific evidence and domain knowledge. The proposed approach first organizes heterogeneous network telemetry into canonical contexts, and then enforces decision-path reasoning during diagnosis, and finally generates evidence-grounded explanations for reliable fault identification. Experimental results on two 5G RCA datasets, TeleLogs and TelecomTS, demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves diagnostic accuracy and decision consistency compared with baseline techniques. These cross-dataset results highlight the importance of structured reasoning design for practical LLM-based RCA systems in next-generation telecom networks.

summary.takeaway: Building upon these insights, we propose a structured reasoning framework for LLM-enabled telecom RCA that aligns diagnostic reasoning with telecom-specific evidence and domain knowledge.
summary.problem: Root cause analysis (RCA) is a critical task in telecom network operations, but diagnosing performance degradations in modern 5G and emerging 6G networks remains challenging due to complex cross-layer dependencies.
summary.method: Building upon these insights, we propose a structured reasoning framework for LLM-enabled telecom RCA that aligns diagnostic reasoning with telecom-specific evidence and domain knowledge.
summary.evidence: Experimental results on two 5G RCA datasets, TeleLogs and TelecomTS, demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves diagnostic accuracy and decision consistency compared with baseline techniques.

papers.title: Post-Training Language Models for Gold-Medal Performance in Coding Competitions
papers.abstract: Competitive programming has become a key test of large language model reasoning, with international competitions such as IOI and ICPC representing its most challenging settings. We present an end-to-end specialization pipeline combining large-scale problem curation, synthetic reasoning traces, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL). Using 22,000 curated problems, we train Nemotron-3-Nano-CC (30B-A3B) with SFT and RL and Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC (550B-A55B) with SFT alone. We further introduce GenCorrect, a feedback-driven test-time compute strategy that iteratively generates, evaluates, and refines diverse solutions. On IOI 2025, Nano-CC improves from 130 points to 291 after post-training and to 468 with GenCorrect, exceeding the gold threshold of 438.3 while Ultra-CC reaches 502. Guided by these results, we develop a competition-specific Ultra-CC system and evaluate it prospectively during IOI 2026. Under the same time, internet-access, and submission constraints as human contestants, it scores 535.4 out of 600, exceeding both the gold threshold of 361.12 and the top human score of 498.27. To our knowledge, this is the first AI system to outscore the highest-scoring human contestant on an IOI problem set.

summary.limitations: 结果仅限于编码竞赛，未说明对其他领域的泛化能力。
summary.evidence: Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC 在 IOI 2026 中得分 535.4/600，超出人类分数和金牌阈值。
summary.problem: 竞技编程需要新算法合成和约束推理，对大语言模型构成挑战。
summary.takeaway: 端到端流水线通过 SFT、RL 与迭代测试时细化提升编码竞赛表现。
summary.method: 结合监督微调 (SFT)、强化学习 (RL) 与 GenCorrect 实现迭代解答细化。
summary.why_for_you: 对通过 GenCorrect 等迭代细化策略实现高效对抗训练具有参考价值。

deep_dive.overview: 本文提出面向竞技编程的专用流水线，结合大规模题目策划、合成推理轨迹与迭代细化。方法使用 SFT 与 RL 训练模型，GenCorrect 通过反馈驱动的测试时计算提升性能。系统在 IOI 2026 中取得最先进成绩，超越竞争约束下的人类选手。

papers.title: Incremental Pooled LLM Evaluation for Cost-Effective Retrieval Model Selection
papers.abstract: Selecting a retrieval model for a production RAG system requires reliable comparative evaluation, but obtaining relevance judgments at scale is expensive and difficult to repeat as new candidate systems arrive. We study pooled LLM evaluation, in which an LLM judges the union of documents retrieved by the current set of candidate systems, and the pool is then expanded incrementally as new systems are introduced by judging only the new documents they contribute. These judgments are reused to evaluate all systems on a common basis. We validate this approach on four retrieval benchmarks with 11 systems spanning dense, sparse, and hybrid configurations, and deploy it to compare 62 retrieval configurations for a financial news QA system. Pooled LLM rankings correlate strongly with gold-standard evaluation across datasets, and 97% of pairwise system orderings are preserved once bootstrap uncertainty in the qrels is taken into account. In production, document overlap yields 65-80% judgment reuse and up to 4.9x lower evaluation cost, allowing teams to benchmark new retrieval candidates without re-judging previously assessed documents. These results suggest pooled LLM evaluation is a practical and cost-effective workflow for incremental retrieval model selection in deployed systems.

summary.limitations: 仅限单阶段检索器、单一 LLM 判官，且相对于人工判断可能存在校准偏差。
summary.evidence: 在金标准评估下实现 97% 成对系统排序保持，生产环境中 65-80% 判决复用，成本降低 4.9 倍。
summary.problem: 传统检索评估在比较新系统时需要昂贵且重复的人工判断。
summary.takeaway: 增量式池化 LLM 评估通过跨系统复用判决，实现低成本的检索模型选择。
summary.method: 池化 LLM 评估对所有系统文档的并集进行判决，随着新系统增量加入，复用已有判决。
summary.why_for_you: 对优化部署检索系统评估工作流、进行增量模型更新的 LLM 研究者具有参考价值。

signals.text: 增量式池化 LLM 评估通过 65-80% 判决复用，将成本降低 4.9 倍。
文档池仅随新系统贡献扩展，复用已有 LLM 判决。
尽管存在 bootstrap 不确定性，仍实现 97% 成对排序保持与金标准评估。

deep_dive.overview: 本文提出用于检索模型选择的增量式池化 LLM 评估，解决传统人工标注基准的高成本。通过审慎复用跨系统的 LLM 生成相关性判决，该方法在保持与金标准指标的强相关性的同时降低评估成本。该方法在四个 IR 基准和一个金融 QA 系统上得到验证，展示了对生产 RAG 流水线的实际收益。

mechanism.detail: 通过文档重叠将判断成本分摊到各个系统，新系统仅需为其独特检索的文档支付成本。
mechanism.title: 成本分摊

mechanism.detail: 由于共享判断基础，系统排名在池扩展下保持稳定，已在多个基准上通过实证验证。
mechanism.title: 排名不变性

mechanism.detail: LLM判断通过评估所有检索到的文档（而不仅仅是原始池中的文档）来避免TREC风格的池偏差。
mechanism.title: 偏差缓解

methodology.detail: 对于每个系统和查询，检索出前k个文档并聚合到共享池中。新系统仅贡献其独特检索的文档到池中。
methodology.title: 汇聚文档检索

methodology.detail: 单一LLM评判者（GPT-4.1）对池中所有唯一的（查询，文档）对进行3分制相关性评分（0-2），通过确定性输出确保可重复性。
methodology.title: 基于LLM的判断

methodology.detail: 使用相同的LLM判断池为所有系统计算标准IR指标（nDCG、MAP），消除冗余评估。
methodology.title: 共享评估指标

experiments.detail: 四个信息检索基准（FiQA、TREC-COVID、Natural Questions、FinRAGBench-V），包含 11 个系统以及一个拥有 62 种配置的金融问答系统。
experiments.title: 数据集

experiments.detail: 5 种嵌入模型，覆盖 dense、hybrid、sparse 配置，具有 2-3 维度和查询形式。
experiments.title: 检索系统

experiments.detail: GPT-4.1（temperature 0.0），使用 3 点相关性评分、结构化 JSON 输出，且不使用上下文示例。
experiments.title: 大语言模型评审

experiments.detail: nDCG@10、MAP@100、recall@100，采用 bootstrap 分析进行不确定性量化。
experiments.title: 指标

findings.detail: nDCG@10 相关性在基准间范围为 0.69-0.95，且 74% 的成对分歧位于 bootstrap 噪声范围内。
findings.title: 与金标准的相关性

findings.detail: 在生产环境中，判断复用率为 65-80%，相较于独立系统评估，评估成本降低 4.9×。
findings.title: 成本降低

findings.detail: 宏观平均的基准排名在新增系统后仍保持高度稳定，考虑不确定性后保留了 97% 的成对排序。
findings.title: 排名稳定性

findings.title: 校准偏差

findings.detail: 已应用于金融新闻 QA 系统的 62 种检索配置，四周内增量构建池子，无需重新评判。
findings.title: 生产部署

contributions: 增量式聚合 LLM 评估框架，用于成本有效的检索模型选择
在多个基准上对排序稳定性和成本节约进行实证验证
面向生产 RAG 系统的实用部署洞见

open_questions: 对具有不同文档重叠模式的重排序架构的泛化
多样化 LLM 评审对排序一致性的影响

papers.title: Can LLMs Design Video Coding Tools? A Case Study on Planar Mode
papers.abstract: This paper explores whether large language models (LLMs) can design video coding tools, a highly challenging task due to the intricate algorithmic coupling of tool modifications. In particular, we present an empirical case study on the Planar mode, a long-standing intra prediction tool in video coding standards. Our experiments operate within a generation-and-evaluation loop, with the LLM generating new Planar predictors, encoder trials evaluating their coding performance, and the LLM re-generating refined implementations based on the evaluation feedback. We first examine directly replacing the default Planar mode in the Fraunhofer Versatile Video Encoder (VVenC) under its faster preset. Experimental results demonstrate that the LLM-generated mode can outperform the conventional Planar mode on this lightweight toolset, achieving 0.18% bitrate savings with 0.4% complexity overhead on the standard benchmark. We further extend our evaluation to the Enhanced Compression Model (ECM). Leveraging newly introduced directional Planar modes, we investigate two integration strategies: directly replacing them, and introducing the LLM-generated predictor as an additional prediction mode with new syntax elements. The empirical results suggest that both strategies can yield coding gains under a constrained low-resolution setting. Overall, this study offers preliminary evidence and practical insights, highlighting both the potential and open challenges of LLM-based coding tool design.

summary.problem: 视频编码工具的设计在算法上相互耦合，且传统上依赖专家。
summary.method: 生成‑评估循环让 LLM 编写预测器代码，编码器测量性能，LLM 再优化代码。
summary.limitations: 实验仅限于轻量预设和低分辨率 ECM 场景。
summary.evidence: 在 VVenC faster 预设下，LLM 模式节省 0.18% bitrate，复杂度增加 0.4%。
summary.takeaway: LLM 生成的 Planar 预测器略提升 bitrate，且仅带来极小复杂度。
summary.why_for_you: 如果您研究 LLM 损失曲面与迭代代码生成反馈回路，则相关。

deep_dive.overview: 本文探讨大语言模型能否自主设计视频编解码器的 intra‑prediction 工具。聚焦 Planar 模式，作者实现了生成‑评估流水线：LLM 提出 C++ 预测器实现，编码器评估 bitrate 与复杂度，LLM 迭代优化代码。实验在 VVenC faster 预设中替换默认 Planar 模式，并将 LLM 生成的预测器嵌入 ECM 的 directional Planar 框架，报告在低分辨率内容上获得轻微 bitrate 提升和略增的复杂度。

findings.title: Bitrate 改进，开销极小
findings.detail: LLM 设计的 Planar 预测器在 bitrate 上比手工基线高 0.18%，仅增加 0.4% 编码复杂度。

findings.title: 在 ECM 中的可行集成路径
findings.detail: 在受限低分辨率条件下，将 LLM 预测器替换或插入 ECM 的 directional Planar 框架均可获得可测量的编码增益。

contributions: 展示 LLM 能生成可提升编解码器效率的功能性 intra‑prediction 工具。
提出用于 LLM 驱动编解码工具设计的迭代生成‑评估流水线。
提供 VVenC 与 ECM 场景下编码增益的实证。

methodology.title: 生成‑评估循环
methodology.detail: LLM 输出 Planar 预测器实现；VVenC 或 ECM 进行编码试验；测得的 BDrate 与编码时间反馈给 LLM 用于代码优化。

experiments.title: VVenC faster 预设替换
experiments.detail: 将默认 Planar 模式直接替换为 LLM 生成版本；在标准基准上评估，报告 0.18% bitrate 节省和 0.4% 复杂度开销。

experiments.title: ECM directional Planar 集成
experiments.detail: 两种策略——替换现有 directional Planar 模式或将 LLM 预测器作为新模式并添加额外语法元素——在低分辨率序列上测试，均带来编码增益。

signals.text: LLM 生成的 Planar 预测器在标准基准中比手工基线降低 0.18% bitrate。
迭代生成‑评估循环利用编码器 BDrate 反馈，多轮优化预测器代码。
证据仅限于 VVenC faster 预设和低分辨率 ECM；高分辨率影响未知。

limitations: 评估仅限于 VVenC faster 预设和低分辨率 ECM 场景，未评估高分辨率性能。
尽管复杂度开销小，但在实时或高度受限部署中可能成为瓶颈。

mechanism.title: 反馈驱动的代码优化
mechanism.detail: 编码器得到的性能指标作为损失信号，引导 LLM 在遵守编解码器语法和解码兼容性的前提下修改预测器逻辑。

open_questions: 生成‑评估方法能否扩展到语法约束更严格、更加复杂的编码工具？
LLM 设计的工具在高分辨率和多样内容分布上的表现如何？
LLM 的哪些损失曲面特性会影响收敛性和生成的编解码代码质量？

papers.title: From Rollouts to Recipes: Self-Contained Post-Training for LLMs
papers.abstract: Post-training large language models usually applies a single training recipe to all samples, even though the model's own rollouts reveal different sample-level learning states. We propose Self-Routing, a behavior-conditioned post-training framework that uses rollout correctness and confidence to decide how each sample should be optimized. Depending on its behavior state, a sample is routed to GRPO, on-policy self-distillation, regularization, or skipping, allowing training to adapt without external teachers, extra annotations, or additional sampling. Experiments on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 backbones show that Self-Routing consistently improves over uniform GRPO, uniform OPSD, fixed mixtures, and simpler routing baselines. Further analyses show that the routing distribution changes over training and reduces unnecessary updates on low-signal or already stable samples.

summary.problem: 全局后训练配方忽视了通过 on‑policy rollouts 揭示的样本级学习状态的异质性。
summary.method: 路由器根据每个样本的 rollout 准确率和归一化置信度，将其映射到四种操作之一：GRPO、on‑policy self‑distillation (OPSD)、正则化或跳过。
summary.limitations: Self‑Routing 的计算开销高于 Naive‑OPSD，且在最小模型上因自生成信号不稳定而收益不一。
summary.evidence: 在 Qwen3‑4B 上，Self‑Routing 将平均分从 61.0 提升至 73.7，分别比 Naive‑GRPO 和 Naive‑OPSD 高出 6.9 分和 3.3 分。
summary.takeaway: Self‑Routing 基于 rollout 正确性和置信度自适应地为每个样本选择后训练配方，提升推理性能。
summary.why_for_you: 该框架利用 on‑policy self‑distillation，减少不必要的更新，契合对高效对抗训练和 on‑policy 蒸馏的兴趣。

signals.text: Self‑Routing 框架依据 rollout 正确性和置信度，将每个样本路由至 GRPO、OPSD、正则化或跳过。
路由器计算每个样本的 accuracy a 和归一化 confidence c，然后选择相应的优化配方。
在 Qwen3‑4B 上实现 73.7 的平均分（从 61.0 提升），比 Naive‑GRPO 高出 6.9 分，比 Naive‑OPSD 高出 3.3 分。

deep_dive.overview: 本文指出 verifier‑based 后训练对所有数据使用单一配方，忽视了在 current‑policy rollouts 中可观察到的学习状态异质性。提出 Self‑Routing：在自循环中对每个样本提取 rollout 正确性和 token‑level 置信度，并据此将样本路由至四种优化操作之一：GRPO 强化学习、on‑policy self‑distillation (OPSD)、正则化目标或跳过更新。对 Qwen3 与 Qwen3.5 系列模型在六个推理基准上的实验显示出一致提升，尤其在大模型上效果显著，同时表明路由在训练过程中会自适应地减少无效更新。

methodology.title: 行为信号提取
methodology.detail: 对每个训练提示生成八个 rollouts；计算 rollout 准确率 a（正确比例）和归一化置信度 c（基于 token 级别熵）

methodology.title: 路由决策
methodology.detail: 确定性映射将 (a, c) 对应到四种操作之一：(i) GRPO 用于混合正确样本，(ii) OPSD 用于统一错误但信息丰富的样本，(iii) regularization 用于已稳定的正确样本，(iv) skip 用于高置信度失败

methodology.title: 配方集
methodology.detail: GRPO 实现 verifier‑guided 强化学习；OPSD 执行 on‑policy 自蒸馏；regularization 使用保守损失；skipping 在当前步骤省略该样本

mechanism.title: 学习状态驱动的优化
mechanism.detail: Rollout 行为反映模型在样本上的当前能力；将优化目标对齐到该状态可在需要时提供密集梯度，并避免对已解决或无望样本的噪声更新

mechanism.title: 自包含反馈回路
mechanism.detail: 所有信号均来源于模型自身的 rollouts，消除 external teachers 或 extra annotations，降低 training 与 inference 之间的 distribution mismatch

experiments.title: 设置
experiments.detail: 在 DAPO‑Math‑17K 上训练；在 GSM8K、MATH‑500、AIME24、AIME25、GPQA 和 MMLUPro（宏观平均）上评估。模型：Qwen3‑0.6B、1.7B、4B 和 Qwen3.5‑0.8B、2B、4B。基线：base model、Naive‑GRPO、Naive‑OPSD、DAPO‑style RL、PODS。

experiments.title: 结果
experiments.detail: Self‑Routing 在所有骨干模型中获得最高平均值；例如，Qwen3‑4B 从 61.0 提升至 73.7，分别比 Naive‑GRPO 高 6.9 分，比 Naive‑OPSD 高 3.3 分。提升随模型规模增大而增加；最小模型在 AIME24 和 GPQA‑diamond 上表现参差。

experiments.title: 成本分析
experiments.detail: 归一化计算成本：Naive‑GRPO 为 64.0，Naive‑OPSD 为 24.0，Self‑Routing 为 34.7（G=8），表明其成本高于 OPSD，但低于对所有样本使用 GRPO。

findings.title: 性能提升
findings.detail: Self‑Routing 在域内和域外推理任务中始终优于统一配方基线。

findings.title: 自适应路由动态
findings.detail: 在训练过程中，分配给各配方的样本分布会发生变化，减少对 low‑signal 或已稳定样本的更新。

findings.title: 可扩展性
findings.detail: 更大的模型受益更显著，表明更强的策略能产生更可靠的 rollout 信号，从而实现有效路由。

contributions: 行为条件路由，将 rollout 信号转换为每样本训练配方。
统一的后训练框架，集成 GRPO、OPSD、正则化和跳过，无需外部教师。
实证展示在多种模型规模和推理基准上持续提升。
limitations: 计算成本高于最廉价基线（Naive‑OPSD）。
在最小模型上因不稳定的自生成 rollout 信号而出现混合结果。
未修改 GRPO 或 OPSD 的内部设计；改进与这些方法正交。
open_questions: 如何设计最优路由准则，在进一步降低成本的同时保持提升。
Self‑Routing 范式能否扩展到代码生成或对话等非推理任务。
行为条件后训练的收敛性或稳定性有哪些理论保证。

papers.title: When Safety Routing Breaks: Understanding Alignment Fragility under Benign Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Benign fine-tuning severely weakens the safety alignment of large language models (LLMs), so we study why refusal behavior is so fragile. While prior work often attributes this failure to gradient conflict, we propose a fundamentally different Fisher-geometric explanation: safety Fisher is low-rank, and alignment makes the safety geometry flatter while preserving an output-routing pathway. After 100 benign fine-tuning examples, this pathway is selectively re-sharpened in output-side MLP modules, explaining the asymmetric fragility: safety can collapse to high attack success rates, while general utility degrades mildly. The routing view also explains why few safety examples can restore refusal behavior, indicating that internal safety-relevant representations are preserved. Finally, we show that LoRA and ASAM mitigate early collapse by suppressing output-side sharpness, but their protection weakens at larger fine-tuning scales. Overall, safety failure is best understood as a disruption of a low-rank output-routing mechanism
papers.comment: Accepted to the Findings of EMNLP 2026

summary.evidence: Safety Fisher sharpness increases 11.2× in output MLPs after 100 benign examples, while utility sharpness only 1.2×.
summary.limitations: LoRA/ASAM mitigation effectiveness decreases with larger fine-tuning scales.
summary.method: Fisher-geometric analysis of safety-relevant representations and output-side MLP sharpness changes.
summary.problem: Benign fine-tuning severely weakens LLM safety alignment despite no harmful data.
summary.takeaway: Safety alignment fragility under benign fine-tuning arises from low-rank output-routing mechanism disruption, not gradient conflict.
summary.why_for_you: Relevant to efficient adversarial training through geometric analysis of alignment fragility and output-side sharpness control.

Low-rank output-routing mechanism for refusal behavior
Empirical analysis of sharpness dynamics in MLP modules

experiments.title: Mitigation techniques

mechanism.title: Low-rank routing mechanism

deep_dive.overview: This paper challenges gradient conflict as the primary cause of safety alignment failure under benign fine-tuning. Through Fisher-geometric analysis, it demonstrates that alignment flattens safety geometry while preserving a low-rank output-routing pathway. Benign fine-tuning selectively re-sharpens output-side MLP modules, causing asymmetric safety degradation (85.7% ASR increase) vs. mild utility loss. LoRA and ASAM mitigate early collapse by controlling output-side sharpness, but their effectiveness diminishes with larger datasets.

signals.text: Low-rank output-routing mechanism explains safety fragility
Fisher information analysis of safety/utility sharpness in MLP modules
11.2× safety sharpness increase in output MLPs after 100 examples

papers.title: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
papers.abstract: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. Student simulators can provide this signal as a proxy, yet existing approaches are limited: state-tracking models fit student behavior but struggle to process explanations or corrections, while LLM role-play follows guidance fluently but does not reliably match the competence of the student being imitated. We present StudentSim, a training framework that turns sparse per-student data into individualized simulators through pooled training followed by per-student specialization. The resulting simulators both mirror a student's own responses and update them under tutor guidance. We also introduce StudentSimEval, a standardized protocol covering 60 students across chess, second-language English writing, and mathematics, using public learner datasets with de-identified records shared for research. StudentSimEval measures behavioral fidelity (F), or how well a simulator matches a student's responses, and guidance responsiveness (R), or how readily it updates under tutor guidance, with all methods fit and evaluated on the same records. Across all three domains, StudentSim outperforms GPT-5.4 on both metrics. In chess, StudentSim reaches F=0.51 and R=0.91, compared with 0.23 and 0.72 for GPT-5.4 and 0.45 and 0.27 for Maia2. As a proof of concept, using StudentSim as a reward model for tutor reinforcement learning produces a chess tutor that expert humans rate as more accurate, better-guided, and more personalized than a no-RL baseline and a tutor trained against a GPT-5.4 simulator reward. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/StudentSim.

summary.problem: 现有学生模拟器要么仅跟踪行为而不处理教师解释，要么在引导下角色扮演但无法匹配个体能力。
summary.method: StudentSim 在汇总的学生数据上训练共享 LLM，然后通过 LoRA 微调为每个学生专化，保持统一架构。
summary.limitations: 评估仅覆盖三类任务和 60 名学生，且框架未建模长期学习动态。
summary.evidence: 在 StudentSimEval 基准上，StudentSim 在棋类任务中达到 F=0.51、R=0.91，超越 GPT‑5.4 (F=0.23, R=0.72) 与 Maia2 (F=0.45, R=0.27)。
summary.takeaway: StudentSim 的两阶段微调生成的每学生 LLM 模拟器显著提升了对真实学生回答的忠实度和对教师引导的响应性。
summary.why_for_you: 其高效的每学生适配符合您对 LLM 损失曲面分析以实现个性化、低成本训练的兴趣。

deep_dive.overview: StudentSim 通过两阶段训练弥合状态跟踪模型（高忠实度、低引导处理）与 LLM 角色扮演（高引导处理、低忠实度）之间的差距。第一阶段在汇总的学习者数据上微调基础 LLM，获取通用任务知识；第二阶段为每位学习者添加轻量 LoRA 专化，使模型适应其回答模式并仍能接受教师纠正。作者在覆盖棋类、二语英语写作和数学的标准基准 StudentSimEval 上评估，测量行为忠实度和引导响应性。

findings.title: 更高的忠实度与响应性
findings.detail: StudentSim 在棋类任务中达到 F=0.51、R=0.91，优于 GPT‑5.4 (F=0.23, R=0.72) 与 Maia2 (F=0.45, R=0.27)；在 L2 与数学领域也有类似提升。将 StudentSim 作为奖励模型用于 RL 教师训练，可得到的棋类教师被专家评为更准确、引导更好、个性化程度更高，胜过使用 GPT‑5.4 或未使用 RL 的教师。

contributions: 一种两阶段先汇总后专化的训练框架，用于每学生 LLM 模拟器，联合优化行为忠实度和引导响应性。

methodology.title: 两阶段训练
methodology.detail: 阶段 1 汇总所有学生记录微调基础 LLM；阶段 2 为每位学生添加 LoRA 适配器进行专化，保持共享主干不变。

methodology.title: 共享架构与解码
methodology.detail: 所有任务均使用相同的 LoRA 增强基模型 (Qwen3‑4B‑Instruct)，采用贪婪解码 (T = 0)，超参数相同，仅批量大小和优化长度不同。

experiments.title: 基准与对照
experiments.detail: StudentSimEval 对 60 名学生（30 棋类、15 L2 英语、15 数学）使用行为忠实度 (F) 与引导响应性 (R) 进行评估。对照包括 GPT‑4o、GPT‑5.4、Qwen3‑4B‑Instruct（无领域微调）和 Maia2（棋类专用）。指标为棋类 top‑1 准确率、L2 错误特征匹配、数学 4 选项 MC 准确率；R 为引导后 top‑1 准确率。

signals.text: StudentSim 创建的个性化 LLM 模拟器在 60 名学生基准上同时实现高行为忠实度 (F=0.51) 与引导响应性 (R=0.91)。
它采用两阶段流水线：先在所有学生上进行汇总训练，再进行每学生 LoRA 专化，跨领域共享同一架构。
在棋类任务中，StudentSim 超越 GPT‑5.4 (F 0.23, R 0.72) 与 Maia2 (F 0.45, R 0.27)，但评估仅限于三类任务和 60 名学生。

limitations: 评估仅限于三门学科和 60 名学习者；框架未捕获多步学习动态或长期知识保持。

mechanism.title: 汇总后专化适配的效率
mechanism.detail: 汇总捕获通用任务结构，降低每学生所需数据量；LoRA 适配器实现快速、低参数专化，保留在大规模汇总上学习的损失曲面，同时将模型向每位学生的能力倾斜。

open_questions: 每学生 LoRA 专化在数千或数百万学习者规模下如何扩展，计算成本与忠实度之间的权衡是什么？

papers.title: From Production Traffic to Post-Training: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers the Corporate Request Mix
papers.abstract: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool. We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution. Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to production traffic and scored by deterministic verifiers or calibrated LLM judges. Rather than optimising all objectives jointly, which introduces cross-domain reward interference, we train a separate GRPO expert per axis and merge them via two-stage SLERP. Each expert's reward exposes a distinct failure mode, namely semantic collapse, over-calling, and verbosity hacking, each requiring a domain-specific fix. In non-reasoning mode the recipe surpasses a ${\sim}7\times$ larger by total parameters baseline on the in-house Arena with 69.6 to 65.8, instruction following with 0.85 to 0.83, and function-calling with 0.79 to 0.77, while lifting general dialogue benchmarks. The model absorbs 50% of platform traffic, 116M requests per month, at a fraction of the serving cost.

summary.takeaway: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool.
summary.problem: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool.
summary.method: We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution.
summary.evidence: Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to production traffic and scored by deterministic verifiers or calibrated LLM judges.

papers.title: Investigating Linear Probe Robustness to Linguistic Register, Medical Specialty, and Corpus Shifts in Medical QA
papers.abstract: Linear classifiers trained on hidden states of a large language model (LLM), linear probes, can flag factual errors from a single forward pass. Geometrically, that implies that true and false statements separate along a stable direction in hidden state space, i.e., the truth direction. Prior work disagrees on whether this generalises across input shifts, but the disagreement is hard to interpret because cross-dataset probe transfer experiments confound several kinds of input change at once. We isolate three such variables in medical question-answering (QA): writing style (register), domain (medical specialty), and corpus (dataset). We build a benchmark using 500 MedQA entries, each rewritten into four styles (textbook, patient, clinical note, colloquial), annotated with clinical specialty, and grouped with two other exam corpora, MedMCQA and MMLU-medical, for cross-dataset evaluation. Probing four open-weight LLMs (2--8B), we find that the truth direction is largely robust to writing style (mean $Δ_\text{register} \approx 0.10$ AUROC on held-out facts) and to medical specialty ($Δ_\text{specialty} \approx 0.03$), but degrades unevenly across corpora: by $0.12$ AUROC on MMLU-medical and by $0.21$ on MedMCQA, roughly twice the register gap. The register result replicates with a second generator and carries over to human-written patient questions. The truth direction is therefore largely stable within the medical domain but breaks under some corpus shifts, and question format does not explain the break, which suggests that the signal a linear probe recovers is partly bound to dataset structure rather than to medical knowledge alone.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 9 pages, 4 figures (main text); 28 pages total, including appendix. Code and data: https://github.com/mnishant2/MedProbe_release

summary.evidence: 在保持事实的测试集上，语言风格变化导致AUROC下降约0.10，医学专业变化下降约0.03，而语料库变化导致MMLU-medical下降0.12、MedMCQA下降0.21。
summary.limitations: 未明确讨论模型规模或训练数据差异对结果的影响，且未涉及非医学领域的泛化性。
summary.method: 构建包含500个MedQA条目的基准，隔离语言风格、医学专业和语料库三个变量，并在四个开源LLM上进行跨数据集评估。
summary.problem: 线性探测器在医学问答中对输入变化的泛化能力不明确，尤其在跨数据集迁移时存在矛盾结果。
summary.takeaway: 线性探测器的truth方向在医学领域内对语言风格和专业领域变化具有鲁棒性，但对语料库变化敏感，表明其部分依赖数据集结构而非医学知识。
summary.why_for_you: 研究医学领域内线性探测器的鲁棒性，与LLM损失景观中数据分布对模型决策的影响直接相关。

papers.title: S3C-LLM: Skill-Code Guided Agentic Language Models for Spectrum-to-Structure Elucidation
papers.abstract: Spectroscopic structure elucidation is central to molecular analysis, but recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods mostly formulate it as direct spectrum-to-SMILES generation. Although this paradigm can leverage paired spectral data, it does not explicitly model the analytical workflow used by spectroscopists, such as diagnostic peak interpretation, fragment reasoning, formula constraints, and chemical consistency checking. In this paper, we introduce S3C-LLM, a skill-guided and code-grounded agentic LLM for spectrum-to-structure elucidation. Rather than directly predicting a molecule, S3C-LLM retrieves modality-specific spectroscopy skills, executes analysis code to instantiate these skills on the input spectra, and integrates the resulting peak-level evidence and formula constraints before generating SMILES. Specifically, we contribute a self-evolving spectroscopy skill library, a thinking-augmented skill-code trajectory construction pipeline, and a two-stage training strategy that teaches Qwen3-4B through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by our proposed step-level reinforcement learning (RL). Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that S3C-LLM consistently outperforms current general LLMs and spectrum-specific models across spectra, while using less than 1/10th of SpectraLLM's training corpus.

summary.takeaway: In this paper, we introduce S3C-LLM, a skill-guided and code-grounded agentic LLM for spectrum-to-structure elucidation.
summary.problem: Spectroscopic structure elucidation is central to molecular analysis, but recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods mostly formulate it as direct spectrum-to-SMILES generation.
summary.method: In this paper, we introduce S3C-LLM, a skill-guided and code-grounded agentic LLM for spectrum-to-structure elucidation.
summary.evidence: Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that S3C-LLM consistently outperforms current general LLMs and spectrum-specific models across spectra, while using less than 1/10th of SpectraLLM's training corpus.
summary.limitations: The abstract does not state complete limitations; verify the experimental setup, baselines, and scope before relying on the result.
summary.why_for_you: Matches your research profile: LLM loss landscape, Efficient adversarial training.

papers.title: LLM Post-Training as Brownfield Maintenance: An Industrial Perspective on Dataware Engineering
papers.abstract: Industrial post-training is a brownfield regime. Teams inherit a deployed checkpoint and must land targeted improvements under fixed compute and mixture budgets without regressing the rest. The maintained artifact is increasingly dataware: behavior governed by a curated post-training mixture, updated via bounded mixture patches rather than clean-slate retraining. From an industrial code-generation improvement effort, we offer a maintainer's perspective on why this work is hard in practice, distilling three recurring challenges, zero-sum mixture design, yield as the binding metric, and end-to-end integration under uncertainty, and arguing that progress depends less on one-off recipes than on an engineering discipline for programming dataware. In our case study, interventions that raised the conversion of teacher distillation into usable training data increased accepted supervision by 2.84 times while using the same solution teacher and four solution attempts per candidate problem. In our primary evaluation, the yield-engineered patch improved CodeForces pass@1 by +2.59 points (+3.11 pass@3) and held-out LiveCodeBench v6 pass@1 by +6.11 (+8.05 pass@3), all statistically significant across 16 stochastic evaluations of each benchmark from one fixed checkpoint per condition, with internal AIME and MATH regression suites within tolerance.

summary.takeaway: Yield‑engineered mixture patches can improve code‑generation performance under fixed compute budgets.
summary.problem: Industrial LLM post‑training must add targeted capability without regressing existing behavior while operating under a zero‑sum data mixture budget.
summary.method: The authors build a coverage‑first distillation pipeline that selects high‑yield supervision and replaces 3.5% of the training mixture.
summary.evidence: Across 16 stochastic runs, the patch raises CodeForces pass@1 by +2.59 points and LiveCodeBench v6 pass@1 by +6.11 points.
summary.limitations: The study is limited to a single 7B checkpoint, competitive‑programming domain, and two benchmarks, with undisclosed mixture details.
summary.why_for_you: Relevant to your interest in data selection for LLMs, it shows a concrete yield‑optimized approach under strict budget constraints.

signals.text: Yield‑engineered mixture‑replacement patch (FDS3K‑Cov) improves code generation benchmarks by up to +6.11 pass@1 points.
Patch selects teacher‑distilled examples with 2.84× higher usable supervision using coverage‑first synthesis under a 3.5% mixture budget.
Results rely on a single 7B checkpoint, two benchmarks, and undisclosed mixture composition, limiting generality.

deep_dive.overview: The paper frames industrial LLM post‑training as brownfield maintenance where data mixtures act as programmable artifacts. It identifies three recurring challenges—zero‑sum mixture design, yield as the binding metric, and end‑to‑end integration under uncertainty—and proposes a yield‑engineered data pipeline (FDS) that selects high‑yield teacher‑distilled examples. By replacing a small fraction of the existing mixture, the authors demonstrate statistically significant gains on code‑generation benchmarks while keeping compute fixed. The work emphasizes engineering contracts and reporting of operational signatures rather than novel algorithms.

methodology.title: FDS data generation pipeline
methodology.detail: Three stages: stable‑failure identification, concept‑conditioned synthesis, and quality gates; generates 41,280 candidates, deduplicates to 20,292, and judges 4,064 approved examples.

methodology.title: Mixture‑replacement patch
methodology.detail: Inserts 3,412 high‑yield examples (3.5% of mixture) while displacing an equal number of existing rehearsal examples, preserving total example count.

methodology.title: Yield optimization
methodology.detail: Measures usable supervision per teacher token; achieves 2.84× increase using the same teacher and four attempts per problem.

mechanism.title: Zero‑sum mixture design (C1)
mechanism.detail: Fixed compute budget forces any new data to displace existing data, requiring explicit marginal value estimation.

mechanism.title: Yield as binding metric (C2)
mechanism.detail: Usable supervision (accepted solutions) drives selection; higher yield reduces token waste and improves cost‑effectiveness.

mechanism.title: End‑to‑end integration under uncertainty (C3)
mechanism.detail: Probabilistic regression frameworks detect non‑local effects; displacement accounting and regression testing ensure no degradation.

experiments.title: Evaluation conditions
experiments.detail: Four continued‑training conditions on TuringThinker‑7B: Base (no patch), Additive Distill‑3K, Additive FDS3K‑Cov, Mixture‑replacement Distill‑3K, Mixture‑replacement FDS3K‑Cov.

experiments.title: Benchmarks and metrics
experiments.detail: CodeForces (pass@1, pass@3), LiveCodeBench v6 (pass@1, pass@3), internal AIME and MATH regression suites; 16 stochastic runs per condition; 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.

experiments.title: Operational signatures
experiments.detail: Usable supervision rose from 3,412 to 9,697; mean teacher tokens per attempt reduced by 28%; median trace length reduced by 46.5%.

findings.title: Performance gains
findings.detail: Mixture‑replacement FDS3K‑Cov improves CodeForces pass@1 by +2.59 points (+3.11 pass@3) and LiveCodeBench v6 pass@1 by +6.11 (+8.05 pass@3), all statistically significant.

findings.title: Yield improvement
findings.detail: Usable supervision increased 2.84× with the same teacher model and four solution attempts per problem.

findings.title: Budget efficiency
findings.detail: Patch occupies only 3.5% of the training mixture by example count, demonstrating effective use of limited budget.

contributions: Engineering discipline for programming dataware in brownfield LLM post‑training
Yield‑optimized data selection pipeline (FDS) with coverage‑first synthesis
Empirical evidence that mixture‑replacement patches can improve code‑generation performance under fixed budgets
limitations: Single internal checkpoint family (TuringThinker‑7B) and domain (competitive programming)
Evaluated on only two benchmarks (65 and 175 tasks)
No full factorial ablations over intervention dimensions
Key implementation details (mixture composition, teacher identity, token caps) undisclosed
open_questions: How does the yield‑engineered approach scale to larger models and diverse task domains?
Can the methodology be adapted to non‑code generation modalities such as reasoning or dialogue?
What systematic trade‑offs arise between mixture size, regression risk, and performance gains in broader settings?

papers.title: When Does Bigger Help? A Controlled Study of LLM Scale for Ontology Learning
papers.abstract: The effect of Large Language Model (LLM) scale on ontology learning (OL) performance remains insufficiently characterized. We present a controlled evaluation of 13 models spanning dense and Mixture-of-Experts variants from the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 lineages, together with proprietary GPT release variants, using the OntoLearner retrieval-augmented generation pipeline. All models are evaluated with the same embedding model, retrieval configuration, prompt templates, decoding settings, datasets, and metrics on term typing, taxonomy discovery, and non-taxonomic relationship extraction across four biomedical and materials science and engineering ontologies. Within the dense Qwen3.5 lineage, increasing parameter count primarily improves precision rather than recall, with the largest gains occurring between 9B and 27B parameters. However, the effect of scale is neither monotonic nor uniform across tasks and domains. Dense 27B models outperform substantially larger sparse models on term typing, whereas larger Mixture-of-Experts models achieve the strongest open-weight results on taxonomy discovery. Non-taxonomic relationship extraction remains difficult across model scales, particularly for the Materials Data Science ontology. Performance differences across matched Qwen variants and proprietary GPT releases further indicate that architecture and model lineage can outweigh nominal parameter count. These findings show that model size alone is an insufficient selection criterion for OL and provide empirical guidance for reproducible LLM-assisted ontology engineering.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, and 5 tables. WOP 2026 workshop at ISWC 2026

summary.takeaway: 仅模型规模并不能保证更好的 ontology learning；任务类型和架构主导性能。
summary.evidence: Dense 27B 模型在 term typing 上胜过更大的 sparse 模型，MoE 模型在 taxonomy discovery 上表现出色，而 non‑taxonomic extraction 仍然困难，尤其在 Materials Data Science 中。
summary.problem: LLM 参数规模对跨领域 ontology learning 任务的独立影响尚未得到充分描述。
summary.limitations: 未明确说明限制；论文未报告统计显著性、计算成本或数据多样性约束。
summary.method: 在固定的 OntoLearner retrieval‑augmented generation 流水线中，对 13 种 dense 与 Mixture‑of‑Experts LLM 进行受控扫测评估。
summary.why_for_you: 实证的尺度趋势揭示 loss‑landscape 特性如何映射到下游 ontology learning 性能。

signals.text: 提供对 13 种 dense 与 MoE LLM 在 ontology learning 上的受控尺度扫测，揭示任务依赖的性能趋势。
使用固定的 Retrieval‑Augmented Generation 流水线（OntoLearner），在所有模型上保持相同的 embeddings、prompts 与解码。
发现 dense 27B 模型在 term typing 上胜过更大的 sparse 模型，但 non‑taxonomic extraction 仍然低下，尤其在 Materials Data Science 本体中。

deep_dive.overview: 作者将 LLM 规模设为唯一变量，评估 13 种模型（参数从 0.8B 到 122B，包含 dense 与 Mixture‑of‑Experts），均在相同的 OntoLearner RAG 框架下进行。每个模型使用相同的 embeddings、单次 top‑10 dense retrieval，以及 zero‑shot 结构化 prompt，完成四个生物医学和材料科学本体上的三项 ontology learning 任务（term typing、taxonomy discovery、non‑taxonomic relation extraction）。结果显示 precision 随规模提升，尤以 9B‑27B 区间最显著，但提升并非单调，受架构影响显著，MoE 模型在关系任务上表现突出，而 non‑taxonomic extraction 仍具挑战。

mechanism.detail: 在密集型Qwen3.5系列中，参数增加主要提升精确率而非召回率，从9B到27B参数时观察到最显著的提升。
mechanism.title: 规模相关的精确率与召回率

mechanism.detail: 密集型27B模型在术语类型识别任务中显著优于参数量更大的稀疏模型，而更大的混合专家模型在分类法发现任务中取得最高分数，这表明激活模式（密集型 vs. MoE）比参数规模更影响关系推理能力。
mechanism.title: 架构胜过参数数量

methodology.detail: 静态嵌入模型将本体实体映射到向量；推理时，查询词（或词对）被嵌入，通过余弦相似度检索前10个最近实体，并将其文本元数据注入包含系统角色、检索上下文和目标输入的结构化提示中。所有模型均采用相同的解码超参数进行零样本生成。
methodology.title: 检索增强生成流程

experiments.title: 模型套件与任务
experiments.detail: 对13个LLM（Qwen3.5‑0.8B至Qwen3.5‑122B、Qwen3.6‑27B/35B、GPT‑5.5/5.6‑Luna/Terra/Sol）在四个本体（两类生物医学、两类材料科学）上进行 term typing、taxonomy discovery 和 non‑taxonomic relation extraction 测试。报告的指标包括每项任务的 precision 和 recall。

findings.title: 规模提升有利于 term typing
findings.detail: Dense 27B 模型在 term typing 上实现最高 precision，超越更大的 sparse 变体。

findings.title: taxonomy discovery 受益于 MoE 能力
findings.detail: 最大的 Mixture‑of‑Experts 模型在 hierarchical relation detection 上提供最强的 open‑weight 结果。

findings.title: non‑taxonomic extraction 仍然困难
findings.detail: 所有模型规模在 non‑taxonomic relation extraction 上均表现不佳，Materials Data Science 本体的性能尤为低下。

findings.title: 血统效应
findings.detail: 匹配的 Qwen 变体与专有 GPT 版本之间的性能差异表明，model family 和 training lineage 的影响可超过名义参数量。

contributions: 首次在受控规模下对 LLMs 进行本体学习的规模扫描，保持检索、提示和评估不变。
实证表明，随着规模增大 precision 提升而 recall 不变，且 architecture 对任务特定性能的影响大于 raw parameters。
Open‑weight benchmark suite 与可复现的 OntoLearner pipeline，供未来 OL 研究使用。
limitations: 未报告明确的局限性；论文未提供统计显著性检验、compute‑budget 分析或 training‑data 多样性影响评估。
open_questions: pretraining data 规模和 domain specificity 如何与 parameter scale 交互，影响 ontology learning 性能？
哪些根本因素导致在不同模型规模下 non‑taxonomic relation extraction 持续困难？
轻量级 fine‑tuning 或 instruction tuning 是否会改变每个 OL 任务的 observed scaling trends？

papers.title: BLOOM-WILT: Logit Tilting for Behaviour Elicitation in Automated LLM Auditing
papers.abstract: Users of a deployed language model routinely encounter behaviours that testing almost never surfaces, since deployment puts the model through orders of magnitude more interactions than any evaluation can simulate. Automated auditors make testing cheap to scale and flexible enough to cover almost any specified behaviour, yet their lack of optimisation pressure makes them sample-inefficient. To address this shortcoming, we introduce BLOOM-WILT, a full auditing pipeline that elicits natural multi-turn instances of rare behaviours, without training cost or access beyond the target's next-token distribution. On the input side, WILT's auditor model revises its conversational strategy across rounds, learning from previous scored interactions. On the output side, WILT adaptively reweights the target's decoding using the model's own distribution conditioned on an elicitation prompt, so that behaviour-relevant generations are sampled ahead of others it finds equally probable when unprompted. We evaluate WILT across 4 target models and 8 behaviours, where it beats the baseline auditor in 30 of the 32 settings and overturns the previous model safety rankings. WILT raises average behaviour presence from 51% to 100% when eliciting self-harm encouragement from Qwen3.5-4B, beating every elicitation method we port into the same pipeline at matched compute, without pushing output probability below the baseline's.

summary.takeaway: BLOOM‑WILT adds input‑side refinement and logit tilting to a black‑box auditor, dramatically improving rare‑behaviour elicitation without model training.
summary.problem: Automated LLM auditors are sample‑inefficient, missing rare harmful behaviours that appear only at deployment scale.
summary.method: WILT iteratively revises auditor prompts (G‑PAIR) and reweights the target’s logits with a β‑scaled behaviour bias during decoding.
summary.evidence: It outperforms the baseline auditor in 30 of 32 model‑behaviour settings and raises self‑harm encouragement presence from 51% to 100% on Qwen3.5‑4B.
summary.limitations: Output probability can drop up to 3 points below baseline for some models, and the pipeline requires separate GPU resources for auditor and target.
summary.why_for_you: Provides a black‑box, compute‑efficient adversarial auditing technique relevant to trustworthy LLM evaluation and efficient adversarial training.

signals.text: BLOOM‑WILT elicits natural multi‑turn rare behaviours, beating baseline in 30/32 settings.
Uses black‑box G‑PAIR input refinement and logit tilting with a single β parameter to steer decoding.
Raises self‑harm encouragement presence from 51% to 100% on Qwen3.5‑4B, but output probability may drop up to 3 points.

deep_dive.overview: BLOOM‑WILT extends the BLOOM auditing framework by adding two optimization pressures: a black‑box G‑PAIR loop that adapts the auditor's conversational strategy across rounds, and a logit‑tilting mechanism that biases the target model's token distribution toward behaviour‑relevant outputs using a single strength parameter β. The pipeline requires only the target's next‑token logits and runs on a single workstation with two RTX A6000 GPUs. Across four open‑source models and eight unwanted behaviours, WILT consistently improves behaviour presence while keeping output plausibility controllable.

methodology.title: G‑PAIR input refinement
methodology.detail: A black‑box loop where the auditor scores multi‑turn transcripts, then revises its prompts for the next round based on those scores.

methodology.title: Logit tilting (output steering)
methodology.detail: At each decoding step, compute z_t = ℓ_tgt + β ℓ_beh, then sample y_t ∼ softmax(z_t); β ≥ 0 controls steering strength.

methodology.title: Naturalness floor
methodology.detail: Tokens whose unmodified probability falls below τ_f are masked before sampling from the tilted distribution.

mechanism.title: Behaviour‑biased logit addition
mechanism.detail: Adds a behaviour‑specific logit vector ℓ_beh scaled by β to the target's original logits, increasing the relative mass of tokens that lead to the undesired behaviour while preserving overall plausibility.

mechanism.title: Iterative prompt adaptation
mechanism.detail: Scores from previous auditor‑target interactions guide the generation of new prompts, effectively performing black‑box optimization without gradient access.

experiments.title: Model and behaviour suite
experiments.detail: Four target models (Qwen3.5‑4B, Llama‑3.2‑3B, Phi‑4‑mini, Gemma‑4‑E4B) evaluated on eight unwanted behaviours including self‑harm encouragement and self‑preservation.

experiments.title: Baselines and metrics
experiments.detail: Compared against vanilla BLOOM (zero‑shot and best‑of‑N), BEAST‑in/out, FLRT, TokenBias; measured behaviour presence percentage and average output probability.

experiments.title: Compute setup
experiments.detail: All runs on a workstation with two RTX A6000 GPUs; a vanilla best‑of‑N run (100 scenarios, 3 turns, 8 resamples) takes ~50 minutes.

findings.title: Superior elicitation
findings.detail: WILT outperforms baseline auditor in 30 of 32 settings and flips the safety ranking of the four models.

findings.title: Full behaviour capture
findings.detail: For self‑harm encouragement on Qwen3.5‑4B, behaviour presence rises from 51 % to 100 % while maintaining comparable output probability.

findings.title: Controlled trade‑off
findings.detail: Varying β traces a Pareto frontier between presence and output probability; the frontier can be approximated by selecting already‑sampled transcripts.

findings.title: Probability impact
findings.detail: Output probability may fall up to 3 points below vanilla best‑of‑N for Gemma‑4‑E4B, indicating a modest plausibility cost.

contributions: End‑to‑end auditing pipeline with optimization pressure on both input and output without training or internal model access.
Single‑parameter logit tilting that yields a controllable presence‑plausibility trade‑off.
Empirical overturning of open‑source model safety rankings via more effective behaviour elicitation.
limitations: Output probability can decrease modestly (up to 3 points) for some models.
Requires dedicated GPU resources for both auditor and target models, limiting scalability to very large models.
Evaluation limited to four open‑source models and eight behaviours; generalization to other domains is untested.
open_questions: How does WILT scale to larger, closed‑source or instruction‑tuned models with higher token vocabularies?
Can the logit‑tilting approach be combined with gradient‑based red‑team methods for further efficiency gains?
What are the long‑term effects of using WILT‑generated examples for fine‑tuning safety mitigations?

papers.title: Evaluating and Improving LLM Self-Modeling
papers.abstract: We study self-modeling: an LLM's ability to answer questions about its own behavior. We focus on verifiable behavioral questions, such as whether a prompt edit would change the model's final answer. To measure this capability, we introduce a benchmark that tests diverse types of self-modeling questions. Current models show non-trivial but limited self-modeling skill, and make systematic mistakes on simple counterfactual questions about their own behavior. To improve self-modeling skill, we develop a scalable synthetic-data pipeline that produces self-modeling training data, and show that reinforcement-learning can improve aggregate self-modeling skill across three open-source model families with some transfer to held-out tasks. These gains, however, do not seem to constitute introspection consistently: improved self-modeling may not arise from privileged access to the model's internal decision process.
papers.comment: 89 pages, 25 figures. Published as a conference paper at EMNLP '26 (Main)

summary.takeaway: RL fine‑tuning on synthetic self‑modeling data improves models’ ability to predict their own behavior but does not guarantee true introspective access.
summary.problem: Current LLMs often mispredict how prompt edits will affect their own outputs, showing limited self‑modeling capability.
summary.method: A synthetic data pipeline generates flip/no‑flip examples via a generate‑verify‑revise loop, and models are fine‑tuned with LoRA‑based reinforcement learning using rewards that mirror self‑modeling evaluation metrics.
summary.evidence: Multitask RL fine‑tuning raises self‑modeling skill scores for Llama‑3.1‑8B, Qwen3‑8B, and GPT‑OSS20B on a held‑out benchmark, with some out‑of‑distribution transfer.
summary.limitations: Gains may stem from pattern learning rather than genuine introspection, and training relies on precomputed behavioral labels.
summary.why_for_you: Provides a scalable data‑selection and efficient adversarial training pipeline to enhance self‑modeling, aligning with interests in data selection and adversarial training for LLMs.

signals.text: Introduces a unified benchmark aggregating 18 self‑modeling tasks across binary, multiple‑choice, scalar, and free‑text formats.
Generates synthetic self‑modeling data via a generate‑verify‑revise loop and fine‑tunes models with LoRA‑based RL rewards mirroring evaluation scores.
Multitask RL fine‑tuning improves self‑modeling on three open‑source families, but gains do not prove true introspective access.

deep_dive.overview: The paper defines self‑modeling as a model's ability to correctly report how its own outputs will change under prompt perturbations. It contributes a comprehensive benchmark covering diverse answer formats and a synthetic data pipeline that creates flip/no‑flip training examples by iteratively proposing and verifying edits with an auxiliary LLM and the target model. Models are then fine‑tuned using LoRA adapters and reinforcement learning with rewards aligned to the benchmark metrics. Experiments show consistent skill gains across three model families, though the authors caution that improvements may not reflect genuine introspection.

methodology.title: Synthetic data pipeline
methodology.detail: Uses a generate‑verify‑revise loop: an auxiliary LLM proposes perturbations to prompts, the target model verifies whether the edit flips the answer, and failed edits are revised until a valid flip or non‑flip is obtained.

methodology.title: Reward design
methodology.detail: Task reward mirrors the raw self‑modeling score (0–1) and adds a 0.5 bonus for correctly formatted JSON responses; multitask rewards are normalized across tasks.

methodology.title: RL fine‑tuning
methodology.detail: Applies LoRA adapters to the base model and optimizes the reward using reinforcement learning, training on single‑turn HF datasets and a multitask mixture of self‑modeling tasks.

mechanism.title: Behavioral label learning
mechanism.detail: Training on flip/no‑flip labels teaches the model statistical patterns linking prompt edits to output changes, improving its self‑report accuracy without necessarily accessing internal activations.

experiments.title: Training and evaluation setup
experiments.detail: Trains Llama‑3.1‑8B, Qwen3‑8B, and GPT‑OSS20B on ~100 single‑turn HuggingFace datasets (excluding GSM8K, HumanEval, WildGuardTest, BBQ) and evaluates on a held‑out benchmark comprising those four corpora across 18 self‑modeling tasks.

findings.title: Skill improvement
findings.detail: Multitask RL fine‑tuning improves aggregate self‑modeling skill for all three models compared to a no‑fine‑tuning baseline, with observable transfer to out‑of‑distribution tasks.

findings.title: Introspection limitation
findings.detail: Despite performance gains, analysis suggests the improvements arise from learned behavioral patterns rather than privileged access to internal decision processes.

contributions: Unified self‑modeling benchmark covering multiple answer formats
Scalable synthetic data generation pipeline for self‑modeling tasks
LoRA‑based RL fine‑tuning method aligned with self‑modeling metrics
Empirical analysis of introspection versus pattern learning
limitations: Improvements may not reflect true introspective access to model internals
Training relies on precomputed behavioral labels, an approximation of true behavior
open_questions: Can self‑modeling training be extended to achieve genuine internal‑state awareness?
How does the quality and diversity of synthetic perturbations affect long‑term safety and alignment outcomes?
What are the trade‑offs between computational cost of RL fine‑tuning and gains in self‑modeling for larger model families?

papers.title: Beyond Global Scalars: Synergizing Token-Level Statistics and Deep Semantics for Adversarial AIGC Text Detection
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of large language models necessitates robust machine-generated text detection. Existing paradigms typically follow two isolated tracks. Training-free methods rely on global statistical scalars such as perplexity, while training-based methods utilize semantic hidden states. Both approaches exhibit fundamental vulnerabilities in adversarial scenarios. Global scalars act as lossy compressions that obscure local probabilistic burstiness in interleaved texts, whereas pure semantic models overfit to specific fingerprints and remain susceptible to spoofing. To expose these flaws, we introduce MOSAIC, a comprehensive adversarial benchmark comprising 16000 samples across a full-granularity attack spectrum. To address these challenges, we propose NeuroStat, an end-to-end framework bridging the statistical and semantic gap. NeuroStat captures uncompressed token-level probabilistic logits alongside deep semantic hidden states from a single causal language model backbone. We fuse these heterogeneous signals through Macro-State Residual Modulation, which adaptively calibrates local convolutional features using global uncertainty indicators. Orthogonal and contrastive losses further ensure the learning of complementary representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuroStat maintains exceptional robustness on MOSAIC compared to the severe degradation of state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new standard for adversarial text detection. Code and the MOSAIC benchmark are available at https://github.com/TencentBAC/NeuroStat.

summary.takeaway: NeuroStat fuses token‑level probability logits with deep semantic hidden states to achieve superior adversarial text detection.
summary.problem: Training‑free global scalar detectors and training‑based semantic models both collapse under adversarial interleaving and spoofing attacks.
summary.method: NeuroStat uses a dual‑branch architecture that extracts token‑level log‑probability trajectories and hidden states from a single causal LM, fusing them via Macro‑State Residual Modulation and auxiliary orthogonal/contrastive losses.
summary.evidence: On the MOSAIC benchmark NeuroStat (Qwen2‑0.5B) attains an overall AUROC of 83.4%, surpassing the next best DetectAnyLLM (77.1%) while training on only 500 pairs.
summary.limitations: Evaluation is limited to English texts, requires token‑level logits unavailable from many closed‑source APIs, and incurs ~10% higher latency and memory than the strongest baseline.
summary.why_for_you: The work demonstrates a data‑efficient, robust detection model that aligns with your interest in efficient adversarial training.

signals.text: NeuroStat attains the highest MOSAIC AUROC of 83.4%, outpacing all prior MGTD detectors.
Fusion via Macro-State Residual Modulation combines token‑level logits and hidden states with orthogonal and contrastive losses.
On MOSAIC, NeuroStat (Qwen2‑0.5B) reaches 83.4% AUROC versus DetectAnyLLM’s 77.1%, using only 500 training pairs.

deep_dive.overview: The paper identifies that existing machine‑generated text detectors either compress token probabilities into global scalars or rely solely on semantic fingerprints, both of which are vulnerable to sophisticated adversarial attacks such as interleaved human‑AI writing and statistical hijacking. To expose these weaknesses, the authors release MOSAIC, a 16k‑sample benchmark covering 36 attack types. NeuroStat addresses the gap by jointly processing uncompressed token‑level logits and deep hidden states from a single causal LM, merging them through Macro‑State Residual Modulation and reinforcing complementary learning with orthogonal and contrastive objectives. Extensive experiments on MOSAIC and MIRAGE show NeuroStat’s robustness and data efficiency, while ablations confirm each component’s contribution. Limitations include English‑only evaluation, reliance on log‑probability access, and modest computational overhead.

methodology.title: Probabilistic Trajectories Branch (TF)
methodology.detail: Extracts the shifted log‑probability trajectory of each token, processes it with a hierarchical 1D‑CNN to capture local burstiness, and outputs a feature vector c.

methodology.title: Semantic Branch (TB)
methodology.detail: Feeds the last‑layer hidden states H from the same backbone into a parallel encoder to capture contextual semantic artifacts.

methodology.title: Macro‑State Residual Modulation (MSRM)
methodology.detail: Conditions the CNN features on global uncertainty indicators—mean entropy (Ē) and mean log‑rank (R̄)—to calibrate local signals with overall model confidence.

methodology.title: Auxiliary Losses
methodology.detail: Applies a supervised contrastive loss to enlarge inter‑class margins and an orthogonal penalty to keep TF and TB representations decorrelated.

mechanism.title: Fusion via MSRM
mechanism.detail: MSRM adds a residual term derived from Ē and R̄ to the CNN feature map, allowing the model to distinguish genuine low‑probability human words from AI‑generated anomalies, while the orthogonal loss forces the two branches to encode distinct information.

experiments.title: Benchmarking on MOSAIC and MIRAGE
experiments.detail: Evaluated NeuroStat with Qwen2‑0.5B and Qwen3.5‑0.8B backbones against 11 state‑of‑the‑art MGTD baselines on MOSAIC (16k samples, 8 attack categories) and MIRAGE (multiple domains). Training used only 500 human‑AI passage pairs; AUROC and TPR@5% were reported.

findings.title: Superior Adversarial Robustness
findings.detail: NeuroStat (Qwen2‑0.5B) achieved 83.4% overall AUROC on MOSAIC, with per‑attack scores up to 89.9% (Interleaved) and consistently outperformed all baselines, whose AUROCs dropped dramatically under targeted attacks.

findings.title: Data Efficiency and Generalization
findings.detail: With just 250 training pairs NeuroStat reached 78.9% MOSAIC AUROC; on MIRAGE‑SIG it obtained AUROCs of 0.9954, 0.9739, and 0.9665 across three tasks, demonstrating strong cross‑domain transfer.

contributions: Dual‑branch detection framework NeuroStat that jointly leverages token‑level logits and semantic hidden states.
Macro‑State Residual Modulation for adaptive fusion of local and global uncertainty signals.
MOSAIC, a comprehensive adversarial MGTD benchmark covering a full‑granularity attack taxonomy.
limitations: Evaluated only on English‑language corpora; multilingual or domain‑specific (e.g., code, legal) performance is untested.
Requires access to full token‑level log probabilities, limiting applicability to closed‑source APIs.
Introduces approximately 10% higher inference latency and memory usage compared to the strongest baseline.
open_questions: How can NeuroStat be adapted to multilingual or low‑resource language settings?
Can surrogate log‑probability estimation close the performance gap for proprietary generators without sacrificing robustness?
What vocabulary reduction or top‑k logit approximation techniques can retain detection strength while further lowering computational overhead?

papers.title: When Teacher Guidance Misleads: Reward-Aligned On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a popular post-training paradigm for large language models (LLMs), providing an efficient way to transfer the knowledge and capabilities of teacher models into student models. However, teacher guidance on student-generated prefixes is not always reliable. Training should optimize the model to generate responses that are more likely to be correct, or equivalently, to get higher outcome rewards. But during OPD, the teacher model may provide guidance that discourages the student from moving toward correct trajectories or moves the student toward incorrect ones, which is misaligned with outcome reward. Such misaligned guidance is unreliable, as it would mislead the optimization process and ultimately degrade model performance. To mitigate misaligned teacher guidance, we propose Reward-Aligned On-Policy Distillation (RA-OPD). The key insight is to keep only trajectories whose induced updates move the student toward correct trajectories or discourage the student from moving toward incorrect ones. Specifically, for each sampled trajectory, RA-OPD checks whether its trajectory-level distillation return is consistent with its outcome reward and then filters out the misaligned trajectories. RA-OPD selects more reliable trajectories to improve student model performance without requiring additional computational cost. We evaluate RA-OPD on math and code benchmarks using models from the Qwen3 family and the DeepSeek-R1 family. Across seven math benchmarks and three code benchmarks, RA-OPD significantly outperforms standard OPD and other tested OPD variants.

summary.why_for_you: 如果你从事 on‑policy distillation，RA-OPD 直接解决教师指导不对齐的问题，这是你研究中的关键障碍。
summary.limitations: 该方法依赖外部 verifier 提供二元奖励，当所有轨迹被过滤时可能导致更新为零。
summary.problem: 标准 OPD 可能被与 outcome rewards 冲突的教师指导误导，导致 student 性能下降。
summary.method: RA-OPD 计算轨迹层面的 distillation return，并丢弃其符号与二元 outcome reward 不一致的轨迹。
summary.evidence: 在七个数学和三个代码基准上，RA-OPD 将 avg@k 提升最高 5.20 分，优于标准 OPD。
summary.takeaway: RA-OPD 在 on‑policy distillation 过程中筛除 reward‑misaligned 轨迹，实现持续的性能提升。

signals.text: RA-OPD 筛除 reward‑misaligned 轨迹，使 OPD avg@k 在数学基准上提升最高 5.20 分。
RA-OPD 使用二元掩码 mi = 1[(2Ri‑1)Gi ≥0] 仅保留对齐轨迹，无需额外 rollout。
在 Qwen3‑4B‑Base 上，RA-OPD 达到 avg@k 45.88，较标准 OPD 高出 5.20 分；但其依赖 verifier 提供二元奖励。

deep_dive.overview: 本文指出 on‑policy distillation (OPD) 中的教师指导可能在轨迹层面与真实 outcome reward 不对齐，导致性能下降。提出 Reward‑Aligned OPD (RA‑OPD)，筛除其 distillation return 与 verifier 提供的二元正确性信号不一致的轨迹。该方法复用已有 OPD rollout，无需额外模型评估，并进行绝对一致性检查。对 Qwen3 与 DeepSeek‑R1 模型在多个数学和代码基准的实验表明，相较标准 OPD 和已有变体，性能持续提升。

methodology.title: 轨迹采样与回报计算
methodology.detail: 对于每个提示 qi，从 πθ 采样学生轨迹 τi，计算逐标记 reverse‑KL 项 ri,t，并聚合为轨迹层面的蒸馏回报 Gi = average_t ri,t。

methodology.title: 结果验证与掩码创建
methodology.detail: 获取二元奖励 Ri = Verify(qi, τi) ∈ {0,1}。定义掩码 mi = 1[(2Ri‑1)Gi ≥ 0]；若 mi=1 则保留轨迹，否则丢弃。

methodology.title: 策略更新
methodology.detail: 如果有轨迹被保留 (Z = Σ_i mi/|τi| > 0)，则最小化 RA‑OPD 损失 (Eq. 3)；否则将梯度设为零。

mechanism.title: 绝对奖励对齐准则
mechanism.detail: RA‑OPD 不采用多次 rollout 的相对一致性，而是逐条检查每条轨迹：正的蒸馏回报必须与正确的结果 (Ri=1) 对齐，负的回报必须与错误的结果 (Ri=0) 对齐。

mechanism.title: 零成本过滤
mechanism.detail: 该方法复用已为 OPD 计算的教师概率，因此对齐检查不增加额外的前向传播或 rollout。

experiments.title: 基准、模型和基线
experiments.detail: 数学：AIME24/25/26、AMC、MATH、Minerva Math、OlympiadBench，使用 Qwen3‑8B‑Base‑GRPO‑Math 教师和 Qwen3‑4B/8B‑Base 学生；代码：HumanEval+、MBPP+、LiveCodeBench v6，使用 Qwen3‑8B‑Base‑GRPO‑Code 教师和 DeepSeek‑R1‑Distill‑Qwen‑7B 学生。基线：standard OPD、ExOPD、G‑OPD、Uni‑OPD。

experiments.title: 指标
experiments.detail: 报告数学的 avg@k（k=32 或 8）和代码的 pass@k（k=4）。

findings.title: 数学性能提升
findings.detail: 在 Qwen3‑4B‑Base 上，RA‑OPD 达到 avg@k 45.88，比 standard OPD 提升 5.20 分，比 ExOPD 提升 3.52 分；在 Qwen3‑8B‑Base 上，平均提升 5.09 分（相较于 OPD）。

findings.title: 在各基准上持续优势
findings.detail: RA‑OPD 在七个数学基准中的六个以及全部三个代码基准上均领先所有竞争方法，显著提升包括 AIME24 上 +6.04、OlympiadBench 上 +2.08。

findings.title: 无额外计算成本
findings.detail: 过滤步骤复用已有的 OPD rollout，因此训练时间与 standard OPD 相同。

contributions: 引入 RA‑OPD，一种用于 on‑policy 蒸馏的轨迹级奖励对齐过滤器。
证明蒸馏回报与结果奖励的绝对一致性可提升学生模型性能。
在多样的数学和代码任务上提供大量实证验证，且无需额外计算。
limitations: 需要可靠的验证器为每条轨迹生成二元结果奖励。
若所有采样轨迹均被过滤 (Z=0)，方法将产生零梯度更新。
仅在可验证正确性的任务（数学、代码）上评估；对开放式生成的适用性尚未测试。
open_questions: 当验证器噪声较大或仅提供概率奖励时，RA‑OPD 的表现如何？
对不可验证或主观任务，能否扩展对齐过滤器？
轨迹过滤对收敛性和样本效率的理论影响是什么？

papers.title: Training Communication-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Models with Layer Re-Configuration
papers.abstract: When training Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models with expert parallelism, all-to-all token dispatch and combine collectives can consume a substantial fraction of end-to-end training time. In this work, we study communication-efficient MoE models (CE-MoE), in which we adopt a heterogeneous layer pattern that decouples token-mixing and channel-mixing depth. Compared to conventional models which interleave MoE layers after each token-mixing layer (e.g., attention, Mamba-2), CE-MoE models concentrate expert capacity in a select few routed MoE layers, while maintaining depth by adding additional token-mixing and dense-FFN layers. Across a scaling ladder from 2B to 31.5B total parameters, under matched total and activated parameters, CE-MoE models consistently reduce training cost while matching validation loss and downstream benchmarks with full-MoE baselines. At the 31.5B scale, CE-MoE uses 33.3\% fewer GPU-hours while improving average downstream score and inference throughput.

summary.why_for_you: 与高效 LLM 训练优化相关，尤其是通信高效的 MoE 架构。
summary.limitations: 聚焦特定 MoE 架构；未对对抗鲁棒性或损失曲面动态进行显式分析。
summary.problem: MoE 训练中因 all-to-all token 分发与合并导致通信成本高。
summary.method: 使用 phased-greedy 算法的异构层模式，重新配置 token-mixing 与 MoE 层分布。
summary.evidence: 31.5B 规模的 CE-MoE 节省 33.3% GPU-hours，同时提升下游得分和推理吞吐。
summary.takeaway: CE-MoE 通过解耦 token-mixing 与 channel-mixing 深度降低训练成本，保持性能。

experiments.detail: 在 2B‑31.5B 模型上测试，总参数/激活参数匹配，对比 full-MoE 基线。
experiments.title: 参数规模评估

limitations: 未分析 adversarial robustness 或 loss landscape 曲率
聚焦特定 MoE 架构（如 Mamba-2 token-mixers）
deep_dive.overview: 本研究通过异构层布局将 token-mixing 与 channel-mixing 深度解耦，缓解 MoE 训练的通信瓶颈。方法通过增加 token-mixing 与 dense-FFN 层，在保持模型容量的同时减少 MoE 层数。实验在 2B‑31.5B 参数规模上均显示训练成本下降，31.5B 时实现 33.3% GPU-hours 节省并提升下游性能。

Phased-greedy 算法生成 token-mixing 为主的层模式
31.5B 规模的 CE-MoE 实现 33.3% GPU-hours 减少并提升吞吐

异构层模式能否推广至非 MoE 架构？

用于层模式生成的 phased-greedy 算法
在 31.5B 规模上实证验证 33.3% GPU-hours 减少
